Name: Collapse Hemispheres
Description: Contralateral and ipsilateral waveforms for an N2pc or LRP, collapsed across the hemispheres: mark which bins are left-side and which are right-side, and this adds a Contra and an Ipsi bin, where contra = (left-side bins at right electrodes + right-side bins at left electrodes) / 2. ERPLAB writes this as contra = (b1@RH + b2@LH)/2; it selects bins and channel subsets at once, so it fits neither bin arithmetic (DefineBins) nor channel arithmetic (DeriveChannels). Electrode pairs are found by mirroring channel positions, falling back to 10-20 odd/even or L/R labels, so any montage works; each pair's waveform is written to both its electrodes, so the channel set and scalp maps are unchanged. Needs an Average carrying at least two bins
